name: AI for Corporate Income Tax and the ASC 740 Provision
description: Evaluate AI-assisted corporate provision work through a cumulative fictional US manufacturer case. Preserve calculation, source, professional judgment and data-permission boundaries while creating reviewable records and a priced evidence-work recommendation.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Corporate Income Tax and the ASC 740 Provision

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 21 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
